comparison.objective: Orient and swipe a magnetic-stripe card once through a narrow reader slot, then return it to its stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-object extraction, orientation, narrow-slot alignment, continuous speed-controlled translation, and reinsertion.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one good swipe across the encoded span at 0.1524–1.524 m/s with correct stripe orientation and height; card returned stably without dropping.
comparison.reason: This tests narrow-slot alignment and controlled one-pass translation. It shares no substantive damper-adjustment, locking, or dynamic energy-absorption outcome with the candidate.
